newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Switzerland to cut tariffs on feed products.
newsitem.headline: Switzerland to cut tariffs on feed products.

text.p: The Swiss government said it was lowering tariffs on imports of feed grains and feed products, effective January 1.

"The Federal Department of Public Economy (EVD) has adjusted various import tariffs on feed grains and feed products in line with import prices," a spokesman for the office for agriculture within the Federal Department said.

The Department, in a statement, said that increased production in major export countries had led to an expected surplus compared with expected consumption, which along with other factors has caused a drop in world grain prices.
For example, the tariff per 100 kilos of hay was cut by 12 Swiss francs to six from 18 previuosly, the spokesman said.
